pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark polygonal regions with highly irregular, jagged, and star-like edge boundaries. The pixel gradients at the edges are sharp, creating a high-contrast transition between the dark interior and light exterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous web of light-grey negative space. Junction nodes are clearly defined where three or four paths converge. Path thickness is relatively narrow, with slight widening between the vertices of adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible as a short, dark, upright mane along the cervical-dorsal line. The 1D silhouette displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth pattern against the background sky.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A localized thinning or structural break in the mane is visible at the posterior base of the neck where it transitions to the shoulder ridge.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A prominent localized area of textural disruption and de-pigmentation is visible on the upper neck, appearing as a pale, irregular patch against the darker pelage.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable pale, de-pigmented patch on the upper neck region suggesting a localized skin anomaly or healed trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific shape and position of the de-pigmented lesion on the upper-cervical region serves as a unique visual marker for this individual.
